title: Crow Crow, Black Crow | kids song, nursery rhymes, english rhymes for toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
Join the little crow on the roof and learn this fun English nursery rhyme with lots of caw caw and yum yum!
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers who love animal songs and bright, happy tunes.
Sing along, flap your arms like wings, and enjoy the cheerful crow family together.

Crow, crow, black crow, sitting on the roof
Caw, caw, crow, come down to the wall
Crow, crow, flap your wings up high
Mum has food for you, come and eat it up

Little crow in the nest, babies in the tree
Mum feeds the baby, look, there's the crow
Crow takes a bite, yum yum yum
Crow drinks water from the pot, glug glug glug

Crow, crow, black crow, sitting on the roof
Caw, caw, crow, come down to the wall

Crow, crow, black crow, flying far away
Caw, caw, crow, come back another day
Crow, crow, flap your wings up high
Mum has food for you, come and eat it up

Crow, crow, black crow, sitting on the roof
Caw, caw, crow, come down to the wall

Crow, crow, flap your wings and fly away
Caw, caw, crow, come back to play
